Camera and lens are resting on a retailer box labeled 'McSteve Online Gadget Store', not on neutral background.

identity.kind: Entry-level DSLR camera with telephoto zoom lens

claims.claim: Working perfectly ok with no fault

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or have sensor/shutter faults (dead pixels, shutter count very high, mirror/focus issues).
risks.proof: Photo or short video of camera powered on showing live view/image on LCD, plus a shutter-count screen (via menu or EXIF of a test shot).

risks.risk: LCD screen could be cracked, dim, or dead given no photo of it illuminated.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rear screen turned on.

risks.risk: Lens autofocus motor (AF-P) or zoom ring may be stiff/faulty; AF-P lenses are known to need camera firmware compatibility.
risks.proof: Video clip of lens focusing and zooming while mounted and powered.

risks.risk: Visible wear on grip (photo 2) may indicate heavier use than disclosed, possibly affecting internal wear/shutter life.
risks.proof: Clear close-up of the worn grip area and any serial/model plate near it.
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavy cosmetic wear, lower tier

risks.risk: No battery, charger, memory card, or strap confirmed included, which affects total value of the lot.
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body and lens only, no accessories

risks.risk: Lens glass condition (fungus, haze, scratches) cannot be verified from current angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photo through the front element with a light source behind, and of the rear element.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens with optical defects

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the model badge/nameplate confirming 'D3400' (or actual model).
Photo or video of the camera powered on with LCD screen active.
Shutter count screen or a sample photo's EXIF data.
Video of lens autofocus and zoom in operation.
Photo of all included accessories (battery, charger, strap, memory card, caps, box contents).
Close-up of lens front/rear elements for fungus or scratches.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a used Nikon DSLR body with a Nikon 70-300mm AF-P zoom lens, which is enough to price as a kind even though the exact body model is not legible in the photos; all functional claims are unverified so the item is priced at worst case (untested condition, visible grip wear, no accessories confirmed).
